title: I'm Fighting Till the End
notes: Jay was banished at the Round Table by a near-unanimous vote and revealed he was a Faithful; Katie and Shane then murdered Clyde, revealed at breakfast. In the final helicopter mission Katie jumped into the loch to secure the win, bringing the pot to its final $246,300. Episode split follows AV Club's part-one/part-two recap; Reality Tea also says the finale opened with Jay's banishment and Clyde's murder.
